`qrcodegen.py` is the unmodified Python QR encoder from Project Nayuki,
revision `3c6d0b3cefb4e049dc337e82237c9644399716a8`:
https://github.com/nayuki/QR-Code-generator/blob/3c6d0b3cefb4e049dc337e82237c9644399716a8/python/qrcodegen.py

Its MIT license is retained at the top of the file. It uses only Python's standard
library. Pairing codes are generated locally; no pairing URL is sent to a QR service.
